s.en: Far Realm feast failed

s.zh: 远域吃下了扭曲肉，却没有回礼。
s.en: The Far Realm ate the twisted meat but gave nothing back.

s.zh: 地底传来翻搅声：一群血肉兽要钻出来了！
s.en: Churning sounds come from underground: a swarm of flesh beasts is about to burst out!

s.zh: 一股心灵哭嚎从仪式点扩散开来，持续一天。
s.en: A psychic wail spreads from the ritual spot, lasting a day.

s.zh: 远域献飨
s.en: Far Realm feast

s.zh: 远域收下了扭曲肉。仪式点上多了：
s.en: The Far Realm accepted the twisted meat. The ritual spot now holds:

s.zh: 鬼婆集市
s.en: hag market

s.zh: 雾里走来一支古怪的小商队：几个裹着破斗篷、牙齿太尖的老妇人，推着一车冒泡的罐子。她们卖药水、诅咒物和黑暗的书，最想要的是扭曲肉（3 银一份）和畸变膏（18 银一份）。\n\n据说鬼婆走的时候偶尔会留下“礼物”——最好别收。
s.en: A strange little caravan walks out of the fog: a few old women in tattered cloaks with teeth too sharp, pushing a cart of bubbling jars. They sell potions, cursed things and dark books, and most want twisted meat (3 silver each) and twisted flesh paste (18 silver each).\n\nThey say the hags sometimes leave a "gift" when they go; better not to accept it.

s.zh: 鬼婆的礼物
s.en: The hags' gift

s.zh: 鬼婆集市走了，原地留下一件用黑布包着的“礼物”：
s.en: The hag market has left, leaving behind a "gift" wrapped in black cloth:

s.zh: 。上面的诅咒还没散……
s.en: . The curse on it hasn't faded yet...
